{{Quote|Sorry? Oh, yes. They're using the old 15-Rs, so this shouldn't take long.|Niall Piv|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''15-R''' was a type of security technology that was considered old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Club Vertica Casino]] used 15-Rs in its security station on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
